voicemod.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to the Voicemod app (the voice changer program on your computer).

variables.port: The port Voicemod answered on (you can ignore this)

voicemod.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot loses the connection to Voicemod, for example when you close it.

voicemod.voiceChanged.description: Runs when you switch to a different Voicemod voice, whether in Voicemod itself or from Cuebot.

fields.voice: Only react when this voice was chosen, by its name as Voicemod shows it, like "Robot". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any voice.

variables.voiceName: The name of the new voice
variables.previousVoiceName: The name of the voice before
variables.previousVoiceId: The ID of the voice before

voicemod.voiceChangerToggled.description: Runs when the voice changer is turned on or off in Voicemod.

fields.stateFilter: Choose On to react only when it is turned on, Off only when it is turned off, or Any for both.

variables.enabled: True when the voice changer is on now

voicemod.hearMyselfToggled.description: Runs when 'hear my voice' (listening to yourself through your headphones) is turned on or off in Voicemod.

fields.stateFilter: Choose On to react only when it is turned on, Off only when it is turned off, or Any for both.

variables.enabled: True when hearing yourself is on now

voicemod.backgroundEffectsToggled.description: Runs when the background sound effects in Voicemod are turned on or off.

fields.stateFilter: Choose On to react only when it is turned on, Off only when it is turned off, or Any for both.

variables.enabled: True when background effects are on now

voicemod.muteToggled.description: Runs when your microphone is muted or unmuted in Voicemod.

fields.stateFilter: Choose On to react only when the mic gets muted, Off only when it gets unmuted, or Any for both.

variables.muted: True when the microphone is muted now

voicemod.soundboardChanged.description: Runs when Voicemod's soundboard changes, for example when you pick another soundboard or the list of sounds updates.

variables.soundboard.name: The name of the active soundboard
variables.soundboard.id: The ID of the active soundboard
variables.soundCount: How many sounds were loaded (only sometimes given)

voicemod.selectVoice.description: Switches Voicemod to a voice of your choice. Handy as a reward, like a robot voice for a few minutes.

fields.voice: The voice's name as Voicemod shows it, like "Robot", or its ID.

variables.voicemodVoiceName: The name of the voice that was chosen

voicemod.selectRandomVoice.description: Switches Voicemod to a random voice. Fun for a surprise reward.

fields.mode: Which voices to pick from: all voices, Voicemod's free voices, your favourites (the ones you starred in Voicemod) or your custom voices (the ones you made).

voicemod.getCurrentVoice.description: Finds out which voice Voicemod is using now and puts it into variables for later steps.

variables.voicemodVoiceName: The name of the current voice

voicemod.getVoices.description: Gets the list of your Voicemod voices into variables for later steps.

fields.onlyFavorites: Tick to list only the voices you starred as favorites in Voicemod. Untick to list them all.

variables.voicemodVoices: The voice names, separated by commas
variables.voicemodVoicesJson: The full list with details, for people who use scripts

voicemod.setVoiceChanger.description: Turns the Voicemod voice changer on or off.

fields.state: Toggle flips the current setting, On turns it on and Off turns it off.

variables.voicemodVoiceChanger: True when the voice changer is on now

voicemod.setHearMyself.description: Turns 'hear my voice' on or off, so you can listen to yourself in your headphones.

fields.state: Toggle flips the current setting, On turns it on and Off turns it off.

variables.voicemodHearMyself: True when hearing yourself is on now

voicemod.setBackgroundEffects.description: Turns Voicemod's background sound effects on or off.

fields.state: Toggle flips the current setting, On turns it on and Off turns it off.

variables.voicemodBackgroundEffects: True when background effects are on now

voicemod.setMute.description: Mutes or unmutes your microphone in Voicemod.

fields.state: Toggle flips the current setting, On mutes the microphone and Off unmutes it.

variables.voicemodMuted: True when the microphone is muted now

voicemod.playSound.description: Plays a sound from your Voicemod soundboard. Handy for a sound effect reward.

fields.sound: The sound's name as the Voicemod soundboard shows it.

variables.voicemodSoundName: The name of the sound that was played

voicemod.stopAllSounds.description: Stops every Voicemod soundboard sound that is playing.

voicemod.getSounds.description: Gets the list of your Voicemod soundboard sounds into variables for later steps.

variables.voicemodSounds: The sound names, separated by commas
variables.voicemodSoundsJson: The full list with details, for people who use scripts

voicemod.setCensorBeep.description: Turns Voicemod's censor beep, which bleeps out bad language, on or off.

fields.state: On turns the censor beep on. Off turns it off.
